changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.14
changeSet.comment: Register the data move rdr229-reown-repo-stems-from-curator over nexus.catalog_collections (RDR-246, RDR-229): one INSERT into nexus.data_moves, no policy
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO nexus.data_moves (label, template, driving_schema, driving_table, chunk_size, sleep_ms, statement_timeout_ms, verification, on_complete, changeset_id) VALUES ('rdr229-reown-repo-stems-from-curator', 'WITH lck AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(''catalog_owners/'' || current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true))) AS locked ), cand AS ( SELECT DISTINCT split_part(c.name, ''__'', 2) AS stem FROM nexus.catalog_collections c WHERE c.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND c.content_type = ''code'' AND c.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND c.superseded_by = '''' AND split_part(c.name, ''__'', 1) = ''code'' AND split_part(c.name, ''__'', 2) ~ ''^.+-[0-9a-f]{8}$'' AND (nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(c.tenant_id, c.owner_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.owner_type = ''repo'' AND r.tumbler_prefix = replace(c.owner_id, ''-'', ''.'') AND r.repo_hash = right(split_part(c.name, ''__'', 2), 8))) ), stems AS ( SELECT stem, left(stem, length(stem) - 9) AS slug, right(stem, 8) AS hash8, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY left(stem, length(stem) - 9) ORDER BY stem) AS nth FROM cand ), mx AS ( SELECT COALESCE(max(CASE WHEN split_part(o.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', 2) ~ ''^[0-9]{1,9}$'' THEN split_part(o.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', 2)::int END), 0) AS n FROM nexus.catalog_owners o WHERE o.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND o.tumbler_prefix LIKE ''1.%'' ), fresh AS ( SELECT s.stem, s.slug, s.hash8, s.nth, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.stem) AS rn FROM stems s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND r.repo_hash = s.hash8) ), ins AS ( INSERT INTO nexus.catalog_owners (tenant_id, tumbler_prefix, name, owner_type, repo_hash, repo_root) SELECT current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true), ''1.'' || (mx.n + f.rn), CASE WHEN f.nth > 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND r.name = f.slug AND r.owner_type = ''repo'') THEN f.stem ELSE f.slug END, ''repo'', f.hash8, '''' FROM lck CROSS JOIN fresh f CROSS JOIN mx ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING tumbler_prefix, repo_hash ), repo_owner AS ( SELECT i.tumbler_prefix, i.repo_hash FROM ins i UNION SELECT r.tumbler_prefix, r.repo_hash FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND r.repo_hash IS NOT NULL AND r.repo_hash <> '''' ) UPDATE <driving_table> SET owner_id = replace(w.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', ''-'') FROM stems s JOIN repo_owner w ON w.repo_hash = s.hash8 WHERE <chunking_clause> AND t.tenant_id = current_setting(''nexus.tenant'', true) AND t.content_type IN (''code'', ''docs'', ''rdr'') AND t.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND t.superseded_by = '''' AND split_part(t.name, ''__'', 1) = t.content_type AND split_part(t.name, ''__'', 2) = s.stem AND t.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM replace(w.tumbler_prefix, ''.'', ''-'')', 'nexus', 'catalog_collections', 1000, 0, 60000, 'SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections t WHERE t.content_type IN (''code'', ''docs'', ''rdr'') AND t.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND t.superseded_by = '''' AND split_part(t.name, ''__'', 1) = t.content_type AND nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(t.tenant_id, t.owner_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections k WHERE k.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND k.content_type = ''code'' AND k.lifecycle_state = ''live'' AND k.superseded_by = '''' AND split_part(k.name, ''__'', 1) = ''code'' AND split_part(k.name, ''__'', 2) = split_part(t.name, ''__'', 2) AND split_part(k.name, ''__'', 2) ~ ''^.+-[0-9a-f]{8}$'' AND (nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(k.tenant_id, k.owner_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_owners r WHERE r.tenant_id = k.tenant_id AND r.owner_type = ''repo'' AND r.tumbler_prefix = replace(k.owner_id, ''-'', ''.'') AND r.repo_hash = right(split_part(k.name, ''__'', 2), 8)))) AND (t.tenant_id = $1 OR $1 IS NULL)', NULL, 'vectors-067-1');
